theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl N)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₂ θ₂ x Q
